subject: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse

Team —

Quick ask: Acme Pulse (prospect) signed a short pilot mutual action plan (attached) and is requesting a $25,000 free credit grant to run a 90-day pilot across two product teams. The ask exceeds our self-serve promo cap ($5k), so I need leadership sign-off for a one-time high-value promotional grant.

Why this matters:
- Upside: ACV expansion opportunity ~$450k ARR within 12 months if pilot converts.
- GTM signal: strong product-led adoption with 30+ engineers already in the trial.
- Competitive: they’re evaluating two other vendors; credits materially affect lead time to ingestion.

Key details (see credit_summary.xlsx):
- Grant amount: $25,000 (usage credits on hosted API)
- Term: 90-day pilot; unused credits expire after 120 days
- Conditions: convert to paid Dedicated or Hosted contract within 9 months or credits considered promotional only
- Billing impact: one-time promotional credit applied at account level; finance acceptance needed for P&L treatment

Attachments: acmepulse_mop.pdf, credit_summary.xlsx, signed_mutual_action_plan.pdf

Request: Please review and reply with approval or questions. If approved, we prefer to issue the credits via the Console self-serve admin path so the customer can start immediately (faster than a manual billing credit).

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before sign-off:
1) Are we confident the conversion probability is >30% based on engagement signals? Any datapoints from the trial preview?
2) Is there a legal/compliance flag on data residency or special terms in the MOP?
3) Can Finance confirm the accounting treatment (marketing or contra-revenue)?

If answers check out, I’m inclined to approve but would like a brief mitigation plan if the customer doesn’t convert. Can you add a contingency (e.g., scheduled business review after 60 days tied to conversion metrics)?

-Markus
VP Revenue Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse

Markus —

Answers below and I’ve attached the trial metrics export to the HubSpot link for quick reference.

1) Conversion signals:
- 30 engineers invited, 12 active with >1k tokens/day during alpha; two teams have started model evaluation flows.
- Product event: >300 prompt variations in first week, strong vector db usage.
Estimated conversion probability (sales modelling): 35%

2) Legal/compliance: No special data residency in signed MOP. Their legal reviewed and added standard DPA language; Acme uses US region only.

3) Finance: I pinged Rishi for formal confirmation. From past similar grants we typically treat as marketing promotion (contra revenue) but will confirm.

Contingency: I propose a 60-day business review checkpoint — if conversion <15% or no paid engagement by day 90, the AE will escalate for remediation and we’ll add a capped renewal approval for any extension. I’ll schedule the review and add it to the HubSpot timeline.

If that looks OK I recommend sign-off and we issue credits via the Console self-serve path (Admin > Promotions > Apply Account Credit) so the customer can begin ingesting today.

Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse

Team —

Finance perspective:
- Accounting treatment: promotional credit to be recorded as contra-revenue; requires noting the grant in the monthly close pack.
- Risk: $25k is within discretionary promotional budget for Q1 but please tag the HubSpot record and include the signed MOP in the deal record for audit.
- Action: I’ll notify Billing Ops once leadership signs off to proceed with issuance and GL coding.

Please ensure the credit expiration (120 days) and redemption conditions are captured in the account notes. Also confirm whether we should issue as a single account-level credit or split across two sub-accounts (they have two engineering orgs).

Rishi
Finance Manager

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmepulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Pulse pilot logistics (for reference)

Sanjay —

Looping you in on internal approvals so you’re aware of the timeline. We’ve asked for a $25k credits grant to fund your 90-day pilot; internal leadership review is underway. If approved we’ll issue credits immediately via our admin console and confirm the account has two sub-accounts setup for each engineering team.

Quick ask for your team before we issue:
- Confirm which sub-account should receive the credits (team-a@acme or team-b@acme).
- Confirm no special IP/data residency requirements.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao | Senior Sales Rep, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: $25k PLG credit grant for Acme Pulse — APPROVED

All —

Approved. Rationale: conversion probability (35%) + strategic account motion + limited promotional budget for Q1. Conditions:
- Issue as account-level credit but split into two line items (team-a / team-b) per Aditya’s follow-up to keep usage telemetry separate.
- Credits expire at 120 days from issuance.
- Add the 60-day business review on 2026-04-25; Marissa to present adoption metrics and next-step recommendations.
- Finance to log as contra-revenue; Rishi to confirm GL coding and notify Billing Ops.

Operational next steps (Marissa/Aditya):
1) Confirm sub-account allocation with Sanjay (Aditya already looped).
2) Marissa: mark the HubSpot deal record with "promo: high-value" and attach the signed MOP.
3) Billing Ops: issue credits via Console self-serve (Admin > Promotions) and confirm with a DR ticket number in the HubSpot timeline.

Markus Klein
VP Revenue Operations
